content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

Many digital creators face challenges when conventional platforms deny access due to geographical restrictions. COREMERCH's infrastructure is designed to circumvent these limitations. By utilizing tools that are globally accessible and employing cryptocurrency for payments, you can eliminate platform fees that hinder your profits. For instance, while Gumroad charges 10% on every sale, NOWPayments only takes a 0.5% fee. This difference can translate into significant revenue retention, allowing you to keep more of your earnings where they belong.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your digital commerce stack, ensure you have the necessary tools and resources. Start with a reliable hosting platform such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. You'll also need backend logic from Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, order storage via Supabase or Google Sheets, and file delivery using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Most importantly, integrate NOWPayments for your crypto transactions, ensuring you can accept multiple cryptocurrencies with minimal fees. Gather these resources to set the foundation for your online store.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Establishing your payment and delivery pipeline is critical to your success. After setting up your hosting and backend services, integrate NOWPayments to facilitate seamless crypto transactions. Configure automatic payment verification, which will enable instant gratification for your customers upon purchase. For product delivery, utilize Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate file distribution. This combination ensures that every transaction is secure, fast, and efficient, giving you and your customers peace of mind.
Owning your infrastructure means no platform fees eating into your profits.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is set up, it’s time to go live. Double-check that all integrations are functioning correctly. Load your products into the system, and test the payment processing by conducting a trial transaction. Ensure that your product delivery mechanism is activated, confirming that customers receive their digital goods instantly. After these checks, promote your store through social media and relevant channels, driving traffic to your newly established sovereign commerce site.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With your online store operational, focus on scaling your venture. Monitor transaction volumes and customer feedback to identify areas for improvement. Consider upgrading your stack by utilizing the Complete Builder Kit, which includes six blueprints and seven templates for further optimization. This kit streamlines scaling efforts and enhances your store’s capabilities. As you grow, continue to leverage the sovereignty of your infrastructure to maximize profits and retain full control over your digital products.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Eliminate reliance on traditional payment systems and embrace crypto sovereignty.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Start by selecting a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Set up backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto transactions. Store orders in Supabase or Google Sheets. Automate product delivery with Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Test your system with a trial transaction. Launch your store and promote it across your networks.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I accept crypto payments?

Integrate NOWPayments into your digital store. They support over 300 cryptocurrencies and provide automatic payment verification with a low fee of 0.5% per transaction, allowing you to accept payments in a variety of digital currencies.
What tools do I need to set up my store?

You'll need GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend operations, and NOWPayments for handling crypto payments. Additionally, use Supabase or Google Sheets for order management and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for product delivery.
How can I automate product delivery?

Utilize Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate the delivery of your digital products. This allows customers to instantly receive their purchases upon successful payment, enhancing their buying experience.
Is there a better way to sell digital products?

Yes, by using COREMERCH's infrastructure, you can sell digital products without platform fees and retain full ownership of your assets. This approach empowers creators and eliminates reliance on traditional payment platforms.
What are the benefits of using crypto for transactions?

Crypto transactions provide lower fees compared to traditional payment processors, faster processing times, and privacy. With NOWPayments, you can convert crypto pricing in USD at transaction time, optimizing your revenue.
